entities.summary: Petr Bezruč was the pseudonym of Vladimír Vašek, a Czech poet and short story writer who was associated with the region of Austrian Silesia. Petr Bezruč was a poets & playwrights from Opava (1867-09-15, Opava–1958-02-17). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Its legacy: Contributed poetry and drama to cultural canon.
